create_socket_filter: create a SocketFilter from a BPF filter function to process socket packets
attach_bpf_filter: attach a BPF socket filter program to an existing Python socket object
close_socket_filter: close a SocketFilter and release the underlying BPF program file descriptor
review_skbuffcontext: review the SkBuffContext ctypes structure that maps BPF socket buffer fields
build_socket_filter_program: build a BPF socket filter program using prog.create_prog with a filter function
